Name: Instant Color Film FP-100C/FP-100C Silk
Details: Professional peel-apart type ISO 100 instant color film for daylight / electronic flash suited for identification, portraiture and other general imaging applications. 10-exposure packs. Discontinuation of pack film in 2016 made a large amount of camera equipment redundant. Photosize 85x108mm & 102x131mm.
